conditions = [
    (final_df3['R_score'] >= 4) & (final_df3['F_score'] >= 4) & (final_df3['M_score'] >= 4),
    (final_df3['R_score'] >= 3) & (final_df3['F_score'] >= 3),
    (final_df3['R_score'] <= 2) & (final_df3['F_score'] >= 3),
    (final_df3['R_score'] <= 2) & (final_df3['F_score'] <= 2)
]

labels = [
    'VIP Customers',
    'Loyal Customers',
    'At Risk',
    'Low Value'
]

final_df3['Segment'] = np.select(conditions, labels, default='Others')
